method: Normalize each score weight vector a = weight*sqrt(2f(1-f)) by sqrt(aRa); compare their projected marginal Z statistics as (Za-Zb)/sqrt(2-2aRb).
limitations: Exploratory same-outcome Z contrast under common effective N and matched LD; is not a patient-level association or comparison of prediction, FI vs FFS phenotypes, or across-outcome causality. The score weights and candidate/outcome selection are post hoc. FFS weight direction and source alleles require verification; outcome and discovery sample overlap unknown.
